responsibility: Machine description file for NVPTX that defines the RTL-level instruction patterns, unspec/unspecv codes, predicates, constraints, mode iterators, expanders, and output templates used to translate GCC RTL into PTX assembly. It is the declarative instruction-selection companion to nvptx.cc, covering arithmetic, comparisons, barriers, SIMT-related operations, atomics, data movement, and other target-specific insn forms recognized by the backend generators.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem nvptx files, this is the machine-description input for GCC generators: it encodes predicates, constraints, unspec codes, expanders, and insn/output patterns for PTX, whereas nvptx.cc contains handwritten C++ hook logic, nvptx.h defines target macros/types, and nvptx.opt lists options.
